articles.summary: ~29-day half-life Single 320 mg dose of CLYM116 drove near-complete APRIL suppression and 60-75% IgA/Gd-IgA1 suppression through 12 weeks CLYM116 generally well-tolerated, with no serious adverse events, dose-limiting toxicities, or hypogammaglobulinemia Phase 2 NAVIGATE-2 trial in IgA nephropathy
